claims.statement: The troubleshooting guide applies to FPT, GHEC and GHES, broader than the FPT/GHEC verification how-to. The reusable prohibits verifying disposable expiring-service addresses; broad guide availability does not supply missing GHES procedure steps.

The cloud-only restriction section requires a different nondisposable primary address, verification, removal of the previous address and a support restriction review when instructed to change email. Performing these steps does not guarantee support acceptance or automatic restored access.
A noreply address protects commit privacy but does not replace the need for a valid account email. Commit privacy and account recovery prerequisites are distinct.
Verification links expire after 24 hours; an expired link requires another request. A sent message or old link cannot certify fresh verification.

An error within the validity window requires checking the correct signed-in account; the listed troubleshooting sequence signs out, quits/restarts the browser, signs into the account and reuses the link. Browser restart is conditional guidance, not an executed fix here.

If an email is already verified by another user, the guide requires unverifying it on the other account or selecting a different email. It describes deletion from email settings then optional unverified re-addition to retain linked commits, supporting a distinction between verification exclusivity and email linkage.

Linked primary-address and reference pages require separate review; no address removal, support request, browser operation or verification email is performed. The shared-email guidance does not authorize taking over another account.
